GRTE: FLAGG RANCH LIFT STATION WASTEWATER PUMP FOR GRAND TETON NATIONAL PARK

*SOURCES SOUGHT*

Grand Teton National Park has a requirement to purchase a specific hazardous solids handling wastewater pump for the Flagg Ranch Lift Station. Please see the attached draft Specifications sheet for further details. If interested in this upcoming porject, please sent the CO an email at kiara_stewart@ios.doi.gov with your company's details.

***NOTE: This is a Sources Sought posting. Sources Sought's are for informational purposes only. This is not a "Request for Quote (RFQ)" to be submitted. It does not constitute a solicitation and shall not be construed as commitment by the Government. Responses in any form are not offers and the Government is under no obligation to award a contract as a result of this announcement.
